reason: It's a concept for a hotel that doesn't exist, with no real guests and no booking numbers. I can't take a made-up example to my bank manager or my guests, so I wouldn't pay for it this month.
objection: Where are the real hotels you've built this for, and what did their bookings do after? A mock-up with a dhow logo tells me nothing about whether my no-shows would drop.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three named guesthouses they have actually worked with, with booking figures I can phone and check, showing commission and no-show numbers before and after.
